evidence.title: Icons8 - Icons, Illustrations and 3D for Designers and AI Agents
Icons8 Plans and Pricing: AI Tools and Graphics Subscription

name: Icons8
summary: Icon, illustration, 3D and photo packs in 130+ matching styles, with free downloads and an MCP server for agents.
description: Icons8 provides matching graphic assets: PNG and SVG icons in 130+ styles, animated icons, illustrations, 3D models and stock photos, drawn by in-house designers since 2012. It also offers AI generators (icon, illustration, face swap, upscaler), an MCP server that feeds the same packs to coding agents, plugins for Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Google, Miro and Lucid, an API and the Lunacy design app.
contains: PNG and SVG icons in 130+ different styles
free SVG, PNG and animated GIF downloads
illustrations, 3D models (800+ FBX) and stock photos
MCP server for AI agents and coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor)
AI tools: icon and illustration generators, face swap, upscaler, background remover, human generator
plugins: Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Google, Miro, Lucid
API, Line Awesome icon font, OMG IMG, Emoji and SF Symbols alternatives
subscription with AI credits, billed monthly or yearly (save 20%)
